Class User

java.lang.Object
Models.Entities.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
CareerCentreStaff, CompanyRepresentative, Student
public abstract class User extends Object
Abstract base class representing a user in the Internship Placement Management System. All users (Student, CompanyRepresentative, CareerCentreStaff) inherit from this class. Provides common functionality for authentication, password management, and internship filtering.

This class implements encapsulation by keeping all attributes private and providing controlled access through public methods.

Since:
2025-11-18

    • isPasswordValid

      public static boolean isPasswordValid(String password)
      Validates a password against complexity requirements. A valid password must contain:
      • At least one uppercase letter
      • At least one lowercase letter
      • At least one digit
      • At least one special character (!@#$%)
      • Only allowed characters (letters, digits, and !@#$%)
      Parameters:
      password - the password to validate
      Returns:
      true if the password meets all complexity requirements, false otherwise

    • filterInternships

      public List<Internship> filterInternships(List<Internship> internships, String filterType, String filterValue)
      Filters a list of internships based on the specified criteria. Supported filter types include:
      • status - filters by internship status (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Filled)
      • level - filters by difficulty level (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced)
      • major - filters by preferred major
      • company - filters by company name
      • visible - filters by visibility status
      Parameters:
      internships - the list of internships to filter
      filterType - the type of filter to apply
      filterValue - the value to filter by
      Returns:
      a filtered list of internships matching the criteria

    • displayInternships

      public void displayInternships(List<Internship> internships, String filterDescription)
      Displays a formatted list of internships with detailed information. Shows internship title, company, level, major, status, visibility, period, slots, and applications count.
      Parameters:
      internships - the list of internships to display
      filterDescription - a description of the filter applied (for display purposes)
